title: 问 AI 一个问题，它要喝几口水？
title_en: How Much Water Does Your AI Drink?

segments.zh: 你每问 AI 一个问题，
segments.en: Every question you ask an AI

segments.zh: 它可能都在偷偷“喝水”。
segments.en: may come with a secret sip of water.

segments.zh: 一项估算说：聊几十个问题，
segments.en: One estimate: a few dozen questions

segments.zh: 就要喝掉一瓶五百毫升的水。
segments.en: can cost a 500 ml bottle of water.

segments.zh: AI 又没有嘴，
segments.en: AI has no mouth.

segments.zh: 水到底喝到哪去了？
segments.en: So where does the water go?

segments.zh: 今天的烧脑问题：电脑算题，
segments.en: Today's brain teaser: computers do math.

segments.zh: 为什么要用水？
segments.en: Why do they need water?

segments.zh: 认识小芯，一块 AI 芯片。
segments.en: Meet Chip, an AI chip.

segments.zh: 它吃进去的电，几乎全变成了热。
segments.en: Almost all the power it eats turns into heat.

segments.zh: 以前一个机柜大约三到十千瓦，
segments.en: An old server rack used about 3 to 10 kilowatts.

segments.zh: AI 机柜到了三十到一百千瓦。
segments.en: An AI rack: 30 to 100.

segments.zh: 相当于把十几到几十台电暖气，
segments.en: That's like stuffing dozens of space heaters

segments.zh: 塞进一个衣柜。
segments.en: into one wardrobe.

segments.zh: 不赶紧散热，
segments.en: Without cooling,

segments.zh: 芯片就会热到降速，甚至宕机。
segments.en: the chip slows down, or even crashes.

segments.zh: 最省钱的办法：
segments.en: The cheapest fix:

segments.zh: 让小芯“出汗”。
segments.en: make Chip sweat.

segments.zh: 人出汗，汗水蒸发，
segments.en: When you sweat, the sweat evaporates

segments.zh: 把身上的热带走。
segments.en: and carries heat away.

segments.zh: 数据中心的冷却塔也一样：
segments.en: Data center cooling towers do the same:

segments.zh: 让水蒸发，带走热。
segments.en: evaporate water, dump the heat.

segments.zh: 一升水蒸发，
segments.en: One liter of water evaporating

segments.zh: 能带走大约零点六度电的热。
segments.en: carries off about 0.6 kilowatt hours of heat.

segments.zh: 反转一：这水不是“用了”，
segments.en: Twist one: the water isn't used up.

segments.zh: 是“飞走”了。
segments.en: It flies away.

segments.zh: 它变成水汽飘到天上，
segments.en: It becomes vapor in the sky,

segments.zh: 不回本地的河里。
segments.en: not water back in the local river.

segments.zh: 一个中型数据中心，
segments.en: A medium data center

segments.zh: 每天要蒸发大约一百万升水。
segments.en: evaporates about a million liters a day.

segments.zh: 我们粗算一下：
segments.en: Our rough math:

segments.zh: 差不多是小半个奥运标准泳池。
segments.en: that's close to half an Olympic pool.

segments.zh: 全世界算下来，二零二五年
segments.en: Worldwide in 2025,

segments.zh: 数据中心冷却用水约二千二百亿升。
segments.en: data center cooling used about 222 billion liters.

segments.zh: 到二零三零年，
segments.en: By 2030 it could hit 644 billion.

segments.zh: 可能涨到六千四百亿升，差不多三倍。
segments.en: Nearly three times as much.

segments.zh: 中国这边，有团队估算二零三零年，
segments.en: In China, one team estimates that by 2030,

segments.zh: 一年要用掉大约十九个西湖的水。
segments.en: it's about 19 West Lakes of water a year.

segments.zh: 反转二：越省电，
segments.en: Twist two: saving power

segments.zh: 有时候越费水。
segments.en: can cost more water.

segments.zh: 蒸发降温很省电，
segments.en: Evaporative cooling saves electricity,

segments.zh: 所以大家爱用。
segments.en: so everyone loves it.

segments.zh: 改用风扇吹、空调冷，
segments.en: Switch to fans and air conditioning:

segments.zh: 水省了，电就多了。
segments.en: less water, more power.

segments.zh: 一项调查：八成多的运营商挑冷却方案时考虑省电，
segments.en: One survey: 87 percent of operators think about power,

segments.zh: 考虑省水的只有三成多。
segments.en: only 35 percent about water.

segments.zh: 反转三：数据中心爱建在哪？
segments.en: Twist three: where do data centers go?

segments.zh: 电便宜、天气凉的地方。
segments.en: Cheap power, cool weather.

segments.zh: 可全球大约百分之四十五的数据中心，
segments.en: Yet about 45 percent of them

segments.zh: 在缺水的地区。
segments.en: sit in water-stressed places.

segments.zh: 在智利，谷歌一个项目原计划每年用七十亿升水，
segments.en: In Chile, a Google project planned 7 billion liters a year,

segments.zh: 相当于八万人一年的用水。
segments.en: as much as 80,000 people use.

segments.zh: 居民反对、法院介入，
segments.en: Residents objected, a court stepped in,

segments.zh: 最后改成了风冷。
segments.en: and it switched to air cooling.

segments.zh: 内蒙古乌兰察布规定：
segments.en: Ulanqab in Inner Mongolia now says:

segments.zh: 不准用地下水冷却，只能用再生水。
segments.en: no groundwater for cooling, recycled water only.

segments.zh: 好消息是，每度电用的水
segments.en: Good news: water per kilowatt hour

segments.zh: 在一年年变少。
segments.en: keeps dropping.

segments.zh: 坏消息是，AI 长得更快，
segments.en: Bad news: AI grows even faster,

segments.zh: 总用水量还在涨。
segments.en: so total water keeps rising.

segments.zh: 这就像你换了辆省油的车，
segments.en: It's like buying a fuel-saving car

segments.zh: 却越开越远。
segments.en: and then driving much farther.

segments.zh: 友情提示：一个问题喝多少水是估算，
segments.en: Fine print: water per question is an estimate.

segments.zh: 不同模型、不同地方差很多。
segments.en: It varies a lot by model and place.

segments.zh: 用风冷、在冷地方的数据中心，
segments.en: Air-cooled data centers in cold places

segments.zh: 几乎不怎么喝水。
segments.en: drink very little.

segments.zh: 所以电脑算题为什么要用水？
segments.en: So why does computing need water?

segments.zh: 因为算力就是热，水是最便宜的“汗”。
segments.en: Because compute is heat, and water is the cheapest sweat.

segments.zh: 下次 AI 回答得又快又好，
segments.en: Next time AI answers fast,

segments.zh: 别忘了它可能出了一身汗。
segments.en: remember it may have broken a sweat.

segments.zh: 小芯说：多问好问题，
segments.en: Chip says: ask good questions,

segments.zh: 我的汗才没白流。
segments.en: so my sweat isn't wasted.
